title: Underground Tunnel
author: MacKenzie Shirk
summary: Photogrammetry tunnel network with a central junction that opens to the surface. Most tunnel pieces are modular with optional connection sockets; the junction itself is not. Authored with baked lighting.
engineNote: Fab lists Unreal Engine as the only included format for this product, so it is recorded as an Unreal package rather than an interchange-format import. The scene uses baked lighting written for UE4; the page states UE5 users must disable Lumen. No project was opened or performance-tested.

title: Winlu Fantasy Tileset - Dungeon
author: WinLu
summary: A 48x48 pixel-art dungeon tileset covering caves, crystal caverns, sewers, tombs and lava halls, with spike and fire traps, hidden doors and animated portals. The separate non-RPG Maker texture files need manual assembly.
engineNote: The listing documents RPG Maker use plus a separate 'Non_RPGMaker_textures.zip' for other engines. Only ZIP packages are listed, so no native engine project, material/shader set or performance result is claimed; extract and import the sheets manually. Archives were not downloaded or tested.
